name: Neck cream / retinoid for necklines

image.caption: Crema redefinición rostro y cuello pieles normales a mixtas - Lift Contour Face & Neck Cream Normal to combination skins

lead: Neck creams are topical products used to improve lines, laxity, crepiness and pigmentation on the neck and decolletage, and some contain retinoids or other actives. They are a low-intensity option among skincare-oriented users who want a smoother, more even neck.

Ingredients such as retinoids, N-acetyl glucosamine and vitamin K2 are proposed to support skin matrix, hydration or cellular energy. Published studies are small and product-specific: an 85-woman study of a neck cream used twice daily for three months assessed texture, fine lines, laxity and hydration, and a 16-week study of a firming cream reported changes in neck and decolletage signs of aging.

paras: People apply the cream to the neck and chest once or twice daily as part of a skincare routine, often alongside sunscreen. Studies run about 12 to 16 weeks, which is the timeframe users commonly expect for visible skin changes.
Irritation is a general concern for topicals, particularly retinoids, and a case of allergic contact dermatitis to an ingredient in a neck cream has been reported.

angle.text: Neck creams, some containing retinoids, are applied to improve skin texture and tone so neck lines, laxity and pigmentation look less visible. Small product-specific studies lasting 12 to 16 weeks report improvement in skin signs.

lead: Neck creams are topical cosmetic products marketed to improve lines, laxity, crepiness and pigmentation of neck and decolletage skin; some formulations contain retinoids or other active ingredients. They are a low-intensity option discussed among skincare-oriented appearance communities.

Published studies are small, mostly manufacturer-linked cosmetic trials. An 85-woman study of a comprehensive neck cream applied twice daily for three months assessed texture, fine lines, laxity and hydration [1], and a 16-week clinical study evaluated a firming cream containing N-acetyl glucosamine on neck and decolletage signs of aging [2]. Other reports include a nitric-oxide-enhancing neck cream [3], a randomized split-face/neck study of topical vitamin K2 (MK-7) [4], and a case of allergic contact dermatitis to a neck cream ingredient [5].
infobox: Retinoids, N-acetyl glucosamine, peptides, vitamin K2

paras: A 16-week clinical study examined a neck and decolletage cream with N-acetyl glucosamine and other ingredients for laxity, crepiness, deep lines and hyperpigmentation [2]. A study of 85 adult women aged 35 to 65 with Fitzpatrick skin types I to IV used a neck cream twice daily over three months with assessments at baseline and subsequent visits [1]. A 2023 report evaluated a cream developed to enhance nitric oxide availability in aging skin [3]. A 2026 randomized split-face/neck study examined topical menaquinone-7 alongside cell-based mechanistic work [4]. The abstracts available are product-specific, and independent comparisons between creams are not available in the sources reviewed.
A case report documented allergic contact dermatitis to ethylenediamine, a component of aminophylline, in a neck cream [5].
